import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Filter for the top 10 dog breeds by count
top_breeds = data['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().nlargest(10).index
filtered_data = data[data['Rasse1Text'].isin(top_breeds)]

# Create a count plot for top dog breeds by gender
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.countplot(data=filtered_data, x='Rasse1Text', hue='SexLang', order=top_breeds, palette='pastel')
plt.title('Top 10 Dog Breeds by Gender in Zurich')
plt.xlabel('Dog Breed')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.legend(title='Gender', labels=['Male', 'Female'])
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
